findings.title: L-BFGS-B ftol=1e-6 stops most refinements short of the minimum the same solver reaches
findings.claim: On the 8x5 profiles grid (two-zone, DHW off) 219 of 320 production L-BFGS-B runs stop on the ftol=1e-6 relative-reduction test, and re-running the same optimize with ftol=1e-12 at the same seam lowers the shipped objective_value by more than 0.1 % in 15 of 40 cells (max 1.11 %, mean 0.112 %, mean with the best cell dropped 0.087 %), with comfort no worse.
findings.mechanism: _multi_start_minimize and _lbfgsb_restart both pass options {maxiter, ftol: 1e-6, eps: 1e-4}; ftol is relative to max(|f|,1), so an iterate that improves by less than ~1e-6*J (7.8e-5 on a J=78 day) ends the run although later iterations keep descending; the polish restart then re-stops on the same test. maxiter (200/300) and gtol (default 1e-5) are never the binding stop.

findings.metric_definition: rel_gap = (J_prod - J_ftol1e-12)/|J_prod|, J = shipped OptimizationResult.objective_value; counted only where room degree-steps below min_temp are no worse
findings.phenomenon_property: Every L-BFGS-B run the optimizer makes should stop on a criterion that does not leave material descent on the table: the shipped objective must not fall by more than ~1e-4 relative when only the stopping tolerances are tightened.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: Tighten ftol (1e-9..1e-12) in the two options dicts, or add an explicit relative-gap re-polish; price the extra work: nfev median x1.82 (two-zone), x1.59-1.63 (single-zone), max x4.6, which the stress budgets must absorb. Low severity: largest absolute objective gain 0.39 units/day, 0.2-0.4 % of winter-day objectives.
expected_golden_drift: value-bearing plan fixtures whose solves stop on ftol (most non-bang-bang scenarios)

non_findings.claim: gtol (default 1e-5) is not binding: gtol 1e-10 changes no shipped objective beyond float noise.

Seeding/basins: ten extra structural seeds (bang-bang via _price_ranked_start at 0.10-1.50 of the plan's energy, all-zero, all-upper-bound), each refined through production's own _multi_start_minimize, beat production by >0.1 % in 9/40 single-zone cells, but the mean with the best cell dropped is 1.19e-3, the largest cell (11.4 %) is a J=0.31 summer_negative day (0.035 objective units, energy cost worse), and flat-price cells show the same magnitude (flat|shoulder 6.6e-3). Not a price-optimality gap: it is basin selection on the comfort/cycling terms.

The MPC warm-start candidate (#1295) is the previous plan handed over UNSHIFTED by coordinator._warm_seeded, so at the default 30-min interval it is misaligned by 2 steps (32/40 cells, where the plan is not constant); the docstring's 'the same problem one step later' does not hold. Aligning it moves the shipped objective with mixed sign (8 cells better >1e-4, 5 worse), mean 6.5e-4 collapsing to 1.3e-4 with the best cell dropped, and flat-price cells move as much as priced ones. Not a finding at this bar; the mechanism is recorded for the seat that owns MPC (s2).

fd_eps (1e-4) is not a lever: fd_eps 1e-6 and 1e-3 via production's own fd_eps kwarg move the objective with mixed sign on the 15 cells raced (eps6 better in 3 non-trivial cells, worse in 4; eps3 better in 3, worse in 5), never beyond 3.7e-3.
